title: Get a free Target gift card -- here's how!
description: You can get a free $10 gift card with a grocery purchase.

asr.full_text: Yeah target is enticing you to shop there at their stores, specifically to get your groceries. So now through the end of tomorrow, you'll get a free $10 gift card if you spend $50 in groceries at Target. You can get the coupon through their app or text grocery to 827438. There are some items that do not count toward your $50. You've got to look at the website though, ABC15. com Slash smart shopper. That will kind of. Break it all down for you. Twenty minutes

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a local news shopping segment about a Target promotion offering a $10 gift card conditional on spending $50 on groceries. The coupon is described as available through the Target app or by texting "grocery" to 827438, and the frame shows the same instruction. These cues are consistent with ordinary retail-promotion coverage rather than a request for payment, credentials, or other sensitive information.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary reward promotion: a free $10 gift card is tied to a qualifying grocery purchase, with coupon access through an app or text message and stated exclusions.
